H01–H05 target opening/table dataflow, H06–H10 target authentic loop/dispatch/block structure, H11–H14 target actual value/result/address carriers and retry joins, and H15 is a preplanned coherent composition. All helper bodies, declarations, signatures, and suffix remain frozen.
primary_hypotheses: Persistent history-base address explains a native saved-register web.
Native uses three path-local recycling sequences rather than one shared block.
Separate entry index/byte-offset induction and one post-callback clearing address better express native table traversal.
limitations: No compiling, machine scoring, semantic harness, sibling inspection, or adaptive round performed in this lane.
Some lexical control-flow variants may optimize identically; source uniqueness does not imply code uniqueness.
The exported MP_TargetSteerPos ordinary ABI limitation remains fixed.

Source-defined semantic arguments are conditional on valid objects, table/list bounds, conversion domains, and absence of undefined arithmetic; common bounded tests cannot establish gameplay equivalence.
